name: iQ Sawmills
address: 2-4 Newmarket Road, Brighton BN2 3QF, United Kingdom
about:
iQ Sawmills is a modern student accommodation in Brighton, ideally located in the heart of Brighton. The flats offer a wide choice of Studio and En-suite rooms. The flats also offer spacious communal areas for relaxation and enjoyment, such as communal lounges, cinema, and entertainment rooms. The flats are located next to the University of Brighton, and the campus is an 8-minute away. Beautiful surroundings surround the flat, with various fine dining restaurants and amenities within easy reach. With Sainsbury's supermarket just a two-minute walk away, iQ Sawmills is an excellent choice of accommodation for students in Brighton.
 
Features
Open for bookings in 2021, the 45-bed flats are ideal for those who prefer a quieter environment. iQ Sawmills has a choice of 3 En-suite (en-suite, shared kitchen) and 5 Studio (en-suite, separate kitchen) rooms, each of which is well-furnished and well-equipped with an en-suite bathroom. All rooms are equipped with beds, desks, chairs, mirrors and other supplies. There is a laundry room in the communal areas, secure bike storage and social spaces with TVs, such as the shared lounge. Two people can occupy the studio without a surcharge.
 
Sawmills Student Apartments offer high-speed WiFi in all rooms and communal areas. In addition, the flats are monitored by CCTV around the clock to ensure the safety of the students living there. All utilities, heating and contents insurance are included in the rent. A washing machine and dryer are provided in the laundry room, which is coin-operated. The kitchen is equipped with essential kitchen equipment such as a refrigerator, microwave, and hoover.
 
Location and What's Hot?
iQ Sawmills is located in the centre of Brighton, with bus stops close to the flats and a 9-minute walk to the University of Brighton. The flats are surrounded by restaurants, shops, street art, cafes and much more to enjoy this vibrant city. Many supermarkets and shopping centres are close to the flats; Sainsbury's and 365 Shopping Centre are within walking distance.
 
The hostel is a 2-minute walk to Lewes Road, which is convenient for everyday life. There are a variety of restaurants on the street, including Chinese takeaways Oriental Takeaway and China Town 2, a Caribbean restaurant Back-A-Yard, a variety of pizzerias and snack bars, as well as cafes and bars, a convenience store Co-op Food, a grocery shop Turkish Food Market, a yoga studio and a school of yoga & bodywork, a yoga studio and a school of yoga & bodywork. School of Yoga & Bodywork are all very close by. In the centre of Brighton, there are many shopping centres, such as Churchill Square, Marks & Spencer Brighton and many more, with authentic food from all countries.
 
Transport
The University of Brighton is a 7-minute walk from the flat. The flat is close to all primary transport links, 17 minutes by bus and 10 minutes by car to the University of Sussex. Easy access to major shopping centres. 2 minutes walk to bus stop. It is a 25-minute walk to Brighton train station and a 10-minute taxi ride.
 
Security and Services
Dedicated hostel reception is available to residents during working hours. The flats have 24-hour security and an electronic door entry system with video surveillance. External visitors must check in at reception and go through multiple electronic gates to gain access to the hostel.

name: Britannia Study Hotel – Brighton
address: 150 Western Road, Brighton BN1 2DA, United Kingdom
about:
Britannia Study Hotel is a centrally located student hotel, in the heart of Brighton, fitted to the highest specifications. There are fully equipped kitchens/lounges on every floor, furnished with sofas, dining tables, chairs and flat screen TVs. Bedrooms have double storage beds, a laptop safe and small refrigerator, and the en-suite bathrooms have a shower, washbasin and WC.
 
Close to Brighton train station and a short walk from the seafront, Britannia Study Hotel is ideally located near Brighton’s shops, night life, language schools and universities. The city’s transport links make it easy to travel to London; as well as international destinations via Gatwick Airport, which is only 30 miles from Brighton.
 
Features of the building include free Wi-Fi internet access throughout the building, coin-operated on-site laundry facilities, 24-hour reception desk, CCTV and keycard entry to all bedrooms.
 
Minimum age is 18. Minimum stay is 4 weeks. Stays must begin and end on Saturdays or Sundays.
Rates are valid to 31st August 2025, but are not guaranteed and may be subject to change.

name: Gob Abacus Residence

about:
